Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields increased following a sharp drop in the previous session, though the benchmark 10-year yield remained below 5%. Ongoing market concerns regarding artificial intelligence kept investors cautious while strong economic activity and sticky inflation continued to influence bond markets.

Markets.title: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
Markets.summary: EAAA India Alternatives raised about Rs 360 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering. The IPO, which consists entirely of an offer for sale, opens for public subscription on October 26.

Markets.title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
Markets.summary: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year increase in standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore for the second quarter of FY27. This growth was driven by higher net interest income, lower funding costs, and a 17% rise in assets under management.

Markets.title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: Shree Cement reported a 15% year-on-year drop in net profit to Rs 263 crore for the September quarter, marking its third consecutive quarterly decline. Although revenue increased by 24%, soaring fuel costs heavily pressured the company's profitability.

Markets.title: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
Markets.summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year increase in second-quarter profit to Rs 170 crore, driven by business growth and improved asset quality. Following this performance, the bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100% as its loans and deposits expanded.

Markets.title: Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
Markets.summary: Jindal Steel reported a 21 percent rise in second-quarter profit to Rs 771 crore, alongside a record revenue of Rs 19,448 crore. The earnings growth was driven by higher steel production and sales, resulting in a 33 percent increase in adjusted EBITDA and a sequential decline in net debt.

Geo-Political.title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
Geo-Political.summary: One person was killed and five others were wounded in a series of shootings near Paris. French authorities have apprehended the suspected gunman and are investigating the incident as a terrorist crime.

Geo-Political.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen killed seven people and injured 34 others at a church funeral in Jordan's Karak governorate. Authorities have launched a manhunt to find the attackers.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli forces began demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron following the fatal shooting of two Israeli soldiers at a checkpoint by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday morning. The attack occurred outside the West Bank city.

Geo-Political.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
Geo-Political.summary: The White House announced that Melania Trump successfully brokered a truce in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky. Residents of the city had been reduced to eating garden weeds in order to survive.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine stated that SpaceX's Starlink satellite internet service remains restricted for its military operations. This contradicts a claim by U.S. President-elect Donald Trump that the limitations had already been lifted.

Geo-Political.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
Geo-Political.summary: Following a tanker strike, an oil spill has washed up on the coastline of the United Arab Emirates. Satellite images show the oil spreading for miles, creating a threat to local marine wildlife.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, increased new orders, and lower inflation. However, job creation slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent of earners is insufficient for solving income inequality on its own. How governments choose to spend their revenue ultimately determines whether social and economic systems are truly just.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot cargo purchases as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz rose, easing Iran war-related supply constraints.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI MPC minutes show policymakers hold differing views on balancing economic growth and inflation control. Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the outlook for growth and inflation.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two members of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee opposed shifting the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. However, all six members supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

India.title: 'Public Sentiment On Immigration Has Changed': India-Origin Mayors To NDTV
India.summary: Indian-origin mayors stated that public sentiment regarding immigration has shifted. Despite this change, they emphasized that the people in the country remain very welcoming to immigrants.

India.title: NDTV World Summit 2026 Highlights: Actor Kriti Sanon To Discuss 'The Making Of A Modern Star'
India.summary: Actor Kriti Sanon is scheduled to discuss the making of a modern star at the ongoing NDTV World Summit 2026. The flagship event is primarily focused on artificial intelligence, including discussions on its potential risks and its growing role in cybersecurity.

India.title: RBI Governor Was Asked About Tata Sons' Listing. He Read The Rulebook
India.summary: The RBI Governor declined to answer questions regarding the potential stock market listing of Tata Sons. He cited central bank policy of not discussing specific regulated entities.

India.title: DK Shivakumar's 'Sting Op Using Meta Glasses' Charge Against Industrialist
India.summary: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar alleged that an industrialist wore Meta smart glasses to a meeting to secretly record their conversation. Shivakumar stated that the device raised his suspicions about a potential sting operation.

India.title: In Setback For Neha Bora, Court Rejects Her Challenge To Peace Bond Notice
India.summary: A court has rejected a challenge by AISA chief Neha Bora against a police notice requiring her to sign a peace bond. The notice was issued by a special executive magistrate following her participation in recent protests.

India.title: "High Inflation Is Like Tax On Everyone": RBI Governor At NDTV World Summit
India.summary: The Reserve Bank of India Governor stated that high inflation acts as a universal tax during the NDTV World Summit. He noted this while the government mandates the central bank to maintain inflation at 4 percent, with a 2 percent margin on either side.

General.title: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
General.summary: Meghan Markle stated she was informed in 2018 about disturbing allegations against her father, Thomas Markle. The statement follows reports that her father is being investigated for child sex abuse images in the Philippines.

General.title: Meghan statement offers answers after years of questions about her relationship with father
General.summary: Meghan released a statement addressing years of questions regarding her relationship with her father. Her statement claims vindication, though she did not explicitly use the word.

General.title: Watch: Moment part of Brighton's historic West Pier collapses
General.summary: During Storm Austen, part of Brighton's historic West Pier was battered by large waves and collapsed into the water. Footage captured the moment the famous landmark suffered the structural failure.

General.title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
General.summary: A deadly shooting near Paris left one person dead and five wounded. French authorities are investigating the series of attacks as a crime of terrorism after apprehending the suspected gunman.

General.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
General.summary: Ukraine and Russia confirmed a truce in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky after the White House stated that Melania Trump brokered the agreement. Residents of the city had previously been forced to eat garden weeds to survive.

General.title: Bayern Munich manager Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at training
General.summary: Bayern Munich manager Vincent Kompany was taken to the hospital after collapsing on Friday. He fell ill while watching the club's second team training session.
